description: Hollow Knight: Silksong item randomizer support for the uploaded BepInEx client.

v0.4.2.description:
### Important

[Made a Trello](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) where I document things that need fixing, things that are done (but might not be in most recent ver yet) and other stuff

When reporting problems please make sure it isn't in the to-fix or long term to-do

### Changelog

- Phantoms cross stich event doesn't softlock anymore
- Added Pollip Heart randomization with six Shellwood checks and six progressive hearts. The Pollip wish now reflects received AP hearts in fresh runs and Pollip Pouch requires all six when the category is randomized
- Added Tool Pouch randomization with four checks and four progressive upgrades. Repeated Crafting Kits, Tool Pouches, Silk Hearts, Claw Mirrors and Curveclaws now maintain their proper progression counts across saves and offline map logic
- Added Restoration of Bellhart as its own QuestSanity check. Also added optional individual relic turn-ins for Scrounge relics and Cardinius cylinders
- Added separate price randomization for shops, Bellways, maps, pins, Needle upgrades and Wish donations. Expensive Shell Shard donations now account for Tool Pouch capacity
- Added the experimental Bone Bottom starting location. Act 2 goal seeds now remove confirmed Act 3-only sources and dependent checks while keeping Silk Soar in the pool as optional post-goal progression
- Flea Hunt now counts all 30 distinct received AP Fleas, including Kratt, Vog and Huge Flea. Goal completion also resynchronizes correctly after saving or reconnecting
- Expanded and tightened room logic across Bone Bottom, The Marrow, Weavenest Atla, Wormways and Deep Docks. Checks with known conservative routes are usable, while genuinely unknown routes remain safely blocked from progression placement
- Corrected many individual access rules, including Grindle, Greymoor Tower Flea, Greymoor Silkeater, Shellwood shard caches, several Memory Lockets and the Bone Bottom statue cache. False Needolin requirements were removed from the Citadel entrance and Cogwork Dancers elevator
- Added the correct Surgeon’s Key requirements for The Unravelled, its Silk Heart and the Underworks Psalm Cylinder. The Psalm Cylinder now uses its real Whiteward route instead of the unrelated Trobbio route
- Fixed physical checks that could remain vanilla, disappear, or fail to report. This includes Pollip Hearts, several inaccessible Shell Shard caches, Mottled Scar Curveclaw and the Hunter’s March and Far Fields necklaces
- The Hunter’s March and Far Fields necklaces are now stationary AP checks that ants cannot carry away. Nearby ordinary rosary caches keep their normal carry-away behavior
- Expanded and corrected map-marker coverage for bosses, Wishes, Tool Pouches, Beast Shards, Pollip Hearts, relic turn-ins and state-dependent shop sources. The Sands of Karak Memory Locket marker and pickup source now point to the correct nook below Watcher at the Edge
- Improved Slab recovery. F4 and every genuine seated bench now restore Hornet’s confiscated cloak, crest, tools and temporary Rosaries and Shell Shards without changing Slab story progression
- Added Naked Trap and improved trap cleanup. Naked Trap can be cleared at a bench, directional input no longer becomes stuck after the trap ends and Stagger Trap uses native recoil without dealing damage
- Fixed post-fight softlocks for The Unravelled and Lace 2 when Hornet has no Silk Hearts. Their existing native recovery branch is now used without granting a free Silk Heart
- Improved memory-fight reliability. Boss checks now trigger at safer victory-only states, while durable AP rewards, DeathLink and resource links survive native memory restoration correctly
- Improved randomized shop previews and item presentation. Shops prefetch the actual AP reward more reliably, Mottled Scar Curveclaw reports the correct check and outgoing items now display an in-game notification
- Crest Slot titles now show Item Name (Player Name) on one readable line. Long player names shrink or ellipsize after the item name and map-marker tooltip text size is configurable
- Improved native inventory synchronization. Physical Bellway purchases unlock their matching destinations, Faydown-only ownership displays the correct cloak and Flea Brew and Plasmium Phial receive one proper initial charge
- Improved several world-state and recovery cases, including Act 3 F4 routing, Cradle map fallback behavior, Wisp Thicket’s randomized Faydown gate, the Moss Mother approach and the Marrow gauntlet’s AP Cling Grip handling
- Updated the bundled companion mods to CrestWheel and Custom Music Randomizer. Fresh Custom Music installs start disabled and its battle handling is safer around arena doors and native fight completion
v0.4.2.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.2

v0.4.2-hotfix.description:
I usually only update once per week but it had some logic bugs that were too severe to ignore

- Gurr the Outcast quest wasn't finishable because Ghillies Doll wasn't something you could pick up
- Logic incorrectly saw the trolley in Marrow as a way to go to Deep Docks despite it needing ot be activated from the right side
- Flea Hunt WinCon now works with fleas in vanilla location
- Zylotol has 2 checks but they were next to each other on the map instead of grouped
- Craggler was missing logic
- Thiefs Mark/Grindle in general cannot be reached with just Silksoar, added Cling Grip as condition until Blasted Steps is fully mapped
- Beast shard rando didn't work until now. Still don't recommend enabling it unless you're a sicko though
v0.4.2-hotfix.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.2 - Hotfix

v0.4.3.description:
I will be taking a break from working on this til Friday as I do have other projects and responsibilities. Do not take these weekly updates for granted as my community and I are working really hard on them so I can only ask to treat it with the patience a non commercial fan-project deserves. There is a [Trello](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) if you want to see what's on the list/what already got done/what's coming but I do these things in bursts whenever time allows me to. Thanks for enjoying this randomizer so far

### Changelog

* Uploaded SilksongRandomizer, CrestWheel and CustomMusicRandomizer to Thunderstore
* Little arrow in F3 menu that lets you switch between Bone Bottom/Bellhart/Songclave as home base (F4 location) as long as you've been there before
* Added Act 1 and Cursed Ending wincons (both need a lot more testing so reports will serve to improve those)
* Option for Vog to give WotH/Foolish/General hints (experimental/still being worked on)
* Loresanity option
* Big update to Shellwood, Bellhart, Sinners Road, Wisp Thicket and Choral Chambers logic
* Several other areas have received a logic overhaul as well

- Added death link cocoon spawn behavior options (vanilla, cocoon, cocoonless)
- Fixed several deathlink related softlocks (entering silkrealm, lace elevator, wish checks being eaten during turn in)
- Flea caravan in Marrow now no longer leave you a choice, Yes and No both send you to Greymoor
- Check names now spell out area first, then item name 
(e.g. Shellwood - Shard Cache 1 instead of Shard Cache 1 - Shellwood)
- Rosary/Shard multiplier option now goes up to 5x and 10x
- Added option to start with map fully drawn
- Added Growstone and Shell Satchel to pool
- With split Swift Step option, enabling early dash only guarantees getting one half early
- Don't auto-switch crest if you do a chapel of a crest you already have
- If you died against Bellbeast, Sherma would be in middle of room during fight
- Act 2 win is not the credits but the final hit on GMS
- A lot more cutscene skipping (pinstress, plimney, etc)
- Sped up a few animations
- Option for in-game markers for melodies and bells to follow the actual checks not their native locations (experimental/so far only functional when zooming in on map)
- Bellsanity actually puts bells for judge door in pool
- There was a spot in Putrified Ducts -> Memorium where the camera locked to a black screen
- Fixed Bellways allowing for purchase to also substitute as AP Bellway ownership
- Volatile Flintbeetles didn't account for whether you can reach all Flintbeetles
- Removed Craggler from boss-sanity. Nobody likes him
- Skai rewrote the README on GitHub. Thank you Skai :)
- The "Victory not able to be created" error is resolved
- Cardinius and the Last Conductor shared one reward template, so load order could make both interactions report the same melody
- Lace 1 check removed for the time being because she pmo (turns out Weavenest Atla and entering Act 2 also deletes her encounter. I'll get back to her in the future)
- Vog and Kratt didn't let you pick up their vanilla loactions if previously received as AP items
- Going to swift step shrine without swift step made the game lie to you and pretend you have it
- Added a Trail’s End requirement option for either Shakra’s 14 purchased map slots or ownership of the 14 map items
- Fixed Ecstasy of the End giving Pale Oil instead of its AP reward and excluded it from Act 1/2/Cursed goals
- Fixed AP-owned Silk Soar not advancing Escape from the Abyss
- Corrected Quick Sling, Loddie, Crawfather and Deep Docks Bellway access logic
- Fixed Greyroot’s cure not restoring crest access
- Skipped the First Sinner memory sequence
- Fixed Fleatopia entering the festival state from the native Egg reward instead of AP Egg ownership
- Prevented nonlethal Shakra spar deaths from triggering DeathLink
- Removed unused item identities, dead location rows and protocol placeholders
- Items in UI were marked as new until native location checked
- Added scuttlebrace_logic (whether the tool should be accounted for in logic), defaulting to false
- LogicUnknown checks remain physically collectable, but considered out of logic with minimal accessibility
- Fixed Shakra repeatedly treating meetings as the first meeting when her initial shop was emptied. Only the exact empty-stock path now records metMapper
v0.4.3.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.3

v0.4.4.description:
This might be the smallest changelog we've had for a full version but that's because I've been grinding the past 1.5 weeks on performance and implementing better logic (obviously it's not perfect yet but we're getting there and the mapping team is GOATed as always) and other fixes that'll be great long term.

I'm also throwing out there that I'm not against being [bought a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) if you enjoy this project because a lot of time was put into this.

### Changelog

Major
* Generation time drastically reduced through proper region system
* Several areas got complete logic overhauls (Wisp Thicket, Weavenest Atla, Whispering Vaults, Blasted Steps, Sinners Road, Hunters March, Far Fields, Whiteward, The Slab, few more pieces here and there)
* Fixed the large-seed connection timeout. New slot data fell from about 885 KB to about 100 KB
* Generic "Simple Key" item in inventory (with a count from 0-4) that on cursor over shows which ones you have and don't have
* Archipelago item in inventory that shows flea amount and last 10 received items
* Alphabet Rando option + Spelling Bee wincon (inspired by/with permission from [TheMathGeek314](https://github.com/TheMathGeek314/AlphabetRando) who did the HK alphabet rando)
   * (English game language only) Randomize 26 letters in pool which will no longer be present in dialog/other text until you find them. Spelling bee wincon is new to Silksong specifically which allows you to type a word/phrase where you only need to find the letters used in it and when you find all it spells out the word big on screen and you win yay)

Minor
- Accessibility rules are no longer messed up, UT also shows accurate things In Logic/Out of Logic
- beast shard in coral_36 didn't spawn
- Fixed invisible Yes/No prompts
- Fixed Act 1 allsanity generation and Memory Lockets clustering in early spheres fixed
- Greatly combed through inacessible regions in act 1/2/cursed to make sure they don't show up
- Restored the Green Prince Simple Key in Act 2 on request
- Fixed Bellway tolls being bypassed after receiving their AP stations
- Fixed Mask Shard Marrow logic
- Added Bell and Song markers to the full/LB map and preserved native marker layer so they render above the map
- Corrected map marker for slab flea
- The inventory map and quill shows what maps you own and don't own on cursor over
- No more mismatch between some options needing "shuffle" while others needed "shuffled"
- Quest requirements are now accurate to AP owned items rather than OG location flags
- Sacred Cylinder fixed this time for real
- Option to hide host/port/name in F3 menu
- After taking flea caravan, F3 now offers Bone Bottom and Greymoor as F4 hubs (until Bellhart is restored, then Greymoor is replaced)
- AP Icons on crest slots show that there's still a check + what degree (filler/useful/progression)
- Cursor flickering during screenshare fix

**Yes you'll need to start a new run if you want to play this version but got something currently going on with 0.4.3 or before**
v0.4.4.title: Silksong Randomizer 0.4.4

v0.4.5.description:
Oops, so much for "one week break" but I felt very guilty over the state of 0.4.4 so I cut it a bit shorter.
This is (despite the amount) a relatively half-baked update since not much was done for logic. The mappers are still working and I only have so much time to commit for it, especially with an event starting up in 11 hours.
(Also obligatory this is for fun/free but if you wanna [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd smile)

# Changelog

**General**
- **Greatly overhauled Abyss story progression**
- Lace Tower and Unravelled Silk Heart memories are skipped 
     - There's also an additional YAML option to have faster (seamless) Silkheart pickup, defaulting to off
- Needle upgrades and Pale Oils now have independent vanilla / anywhere options
- Mottled Skarr: Curveclaw and Fractured Mask now remain collectible as AP checks after the merchant dies. Receiving either tool elsewhere no longer hides its unchecked location
- Fixed Naked Trap persisting during deaths, memory fights, saves and resets
- Reconnects now serialize connection attempts, discard stale-session callbacks and detach old callbacks
- Save rollback now restores received items (it already did before but not as thoroughly as it should've)
- Fixed reconnects unnecessary save hitch
- Removed Hunter’s March - Rosary Chest and Far Fields - Rosary Chest 2
- get_logical_path & explain properly work with UT now (sorry :D)
- Grand Mother Silks title card included in alphabet mode
- Starting-crest slots remain in the pool even when that crest’s vanilla source is beyond the selected act goal
- Fixed infinite jump/wall-slide exploit without Cling Grip
- Cursed Crest bench restoration now refreshes both the spool and crest HUD, but never interferes with the real story curse
- Alphabet/Spelling Bee generation now checks placement capacity and fails clearly instead of producing impossible fills
- Vog hints now use Cogwork Core, High Halls, Memorium or Whispering Vaults instead of the vague Outlying Citadel label
- Closed the abortion clinic on cursed ending wincon (no more self-softlocking allowed)
- Inventory looked fucky while naked trap is happening
- Bone Bottom/restored Bellhart: the title card no longer blocks benches or NPC interaction
- Beastling Call disabled during Act 3 intro
- No sending deathlink for dying during memory fights
- Earlier Silkheart on ability rando to lessen reports over players not knowing that Needolin / Silksoar / Clawline require silk and also to put soar/line into logic earlier since not having silk could lead to softlocks
- No more free dashing during specific frames when only owning one half of split swift step (by Skai)
- Flea Brew refreshes by sitting on benches (by Skai)
- Multibinder purchase mistakenly excluded from Act 1
- Fixed several things being in act 1/act 2/cursed ending when they shouldn't
- After Widow defeat incoming DeathLinks now remain queued until Widow’s shrine completion finishes, then activate somewhere safe
- Bilewater East Memory Locket now identifies the moving hanging-sack pickup by its exact hierarchy
- Crest-slot hints now refresh immediately when scouting finishes instead of appearing blank on the first hover
- F4 and recovery warps are blocked while Abyss Escape is active, preventing the escape sequence from being skipped and story progression from desynchronizing
- Fixed Trobbio’s regular and Tormented Claw Mirror checks not triggering from the proper victory reward states
- Objective Open: Grand Gate properly shows AP-owned bell amount and which ones
- Bells from bellshrine-sanity cannot be put into Act 3 (sorry I forgot the fleas need to pass through Judge arena)
- Receiving the Curvesickle upgrade while Curveclaw is equipped now updates the tool immediately instead of temporarily disabling it until a room change
- Grouped together Far Fields Shell Shard Caches 2-3 and Rosary Cache 18 as one map marker, same with Shell Shard Cache 4-5
- The Blasted Steps entrance sign from Shellwood and the Terminus Commandment are now randomized lore locations
   - The nonexistent Memorium Bone Plaque and Clover Plaque locations have been removed
- Better Bell/Melody tracking if the YAML option to show them on map is on
- Shakra doesn't leave (no need for additional mods) in fact uninstall ShakraAlwaysOnSite, that mod messed with flags (bad)
- Loose Beast Shard checks dropped by enemies are restored after death or a room reload if they weren’t collected
- Alchemist’s Assistant now removes the consumed Needle Phial
- Silk and Soul now recognizes an AP-owned Snare Setter
- Balm for the Wounded should now suppress the original animation and hand over checks no problem
- The second Progressive Claw Mirror properly replaces the first across every crest instead of allowing both mirrors to be equipped
- Drifter’s Cloak now works after Faydown with only one Progressive Swift Step, the physical Cloak pickup is no longer needed
- Open Grand Gate now appears whenever Act 2 begins, regardless of how the player enters Act 2
- Wreath of Purity now spends one of its three charges when blocking a Muckmaggot trap. Once exhausted, the trap applies normally
   - Did I ever even mention that Wreath of Purity can block these traps since 0.4.0 ? Pretty nifty right ?
- F4/recovery warps now fail active courier deliveries through the game’s delivery-breaking behavior
- Collecting the randomized Shellwood Mask Shard didn't fire its original event, causing the intended Phacia ambush to not spawn
- Opened Silkeaters will respawn if player leaves the room or dies without picking it up and only disappear once they're obtained
- Locations sent via /send_location will now disappear as map marker immediately rather than on reboot
- item_link had a funky interaction if only one player had alphabet mode on

**Logic**
* **Added most of Bilewater in logic**
* **Overhauled Putrified Ducts logic**
* Left side Greymoor is still (officially) unmapped but it got some temporary logic to hopefully help the worse parts of it that players can get stuck on
* Blasted Steps Bellway no longer places Sister Splinter in No Skips logic. Its enemy-pogo route requires Easy Skips
* Forge Daughter’s four checks are mapped and no longer LogicUnknown
* Only Shellwood - Weaver Harp Inscription requires Needolin in Shellwood_10, not the Pollip Heart or Cling Grip in that map part
* First Sinner’s logical path now clearly says to collect the fixed vanilla Heretic Key
* Silkshot (Original) reconciles an AP-received Ruined Tool at the repair desk
* Restored Queen’s Egg progression logic using Bellhart, Missing Brother, courier delivery and the precise Styx-room
* Fixed Rite of Rebirth and follow up quest logic
* Fixed Silk and Soul wish being bugged (still needs a major rework though)
* Shellwood Mask Shard: removed the "ledge grab alone" route. Sprint alone no longer reaches it due to player expectations
* Architect's Melody no longer in logic from just Clawline
* Huge Flea can no longer hold required progression until its exact movement requirement is known
* Last Judge and everything beyond the arena now require the exact arena-completion event, rather than becoming available from Blasted Steps Bellway access alone
* Logic now accounts for Grand Bellway as way to enter citadel/act 2 proper (act 1 goals excluded)
* Pimpillo can no longer hold required progression while left-side Greymoor remains unmapped
* Far Fields Shell Shard Cache 8 is restricted to filler/useful items because it can become permanently inaccessible
* Far Fields Rosary Caches 3 and 4 now correctly require Drifter’s Cloak and Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled)
* The Skull Cave Mask Shard and shard cache no longer appear in logic without Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled)
* Entering the Deep Docks mines from Far Fields with Clawline, Silk Soar and one Silk Heart now correctly puts Flintslate, Shard Bundle 1, Forebrothers and the areas beyond them in logic
* Broodfeast now recognizes the appropriate AP-owned tools for all three organ types
* Greymoor’s Silkeater is now LogicUnknown until western Greymoor is mapped
* Great Taste of Pharloom and its Pale Oil reward now require the Last Judge to be defeated (edit: I never considered that the Phantom route is even a possibility. I am part of the problem)
* Adjusted Memorium Spool Fragment and Deep Docks Flea (Mines) logic adjusted to need Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that setting is enabled)
* Cogwork Core - Pristine Core now has proper Act 3 requirement for logic
